plan.title: Decide and execute migrate:vbrief -- TS port or pre-v0.20 cutoff

narratives.Description: The migrate:vbrief verb still dispatches to scripts/migrate_vbrief.py, which blocks the Python purge. This story resolves the open decision: either port the migrator to TypeScript behind the directive CLI, or document a hard pre-v0.20 legacy cutoff and remove the verb from the consumer surface.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Evaluate the two options against pre-v0.20 consumer impact and record the decision, identifying whether the TS module or the cutoff doc is the resulting source change.
- If porting, implement the TS migrate module and a fixture migration test; if cutting, remove the verb from tasks/migrate.yml and the consumer task surface and document the cutoff.
- Verify with `task check` that no remaining code path shells out to the migrate_vbrief.py script.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft maintainer, I want a resolved migrate:vbrief decision, so that the Python migrator can be removed without stranding pre-v0.20 consumers.

items.title: Given the TS-port path, when chosen, then `task migrate:vbrief` runs with no Python and a fixture migration test validates the output.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the TS-port path, when chosen, then `task migrate:vbrief` runs with no Python and a fixture migration test validates the output.

items.title: Given the cutoff path, when chosen instead, then the consumer task surface no longer shows migrate:vbrief and the docs show a hard pre-v0.20 cutoff.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the cutoff path, when chosen instead, then the consumer task surface no longer shows migrate:vbrief and the docs show a hard pre-v0.20 cutoff.

items.title: Given either resolution, when `task check` runs, then it exits zero and no code path invokes `scripts/migrate_vbrief.py`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given either resolution, when `task check` runs, then it exits zero and no code path invokes `scripts/migrate_vbrief.py`.

expected_outputs: either a TS migrate verb or a documented cutoff
